title: The War Between Blacks And Whites

sense.text:
Judas and his brethren, the Maccabees, a group of Levites, “said one to another, Let us restore the decayed” estate of our people. Let us fix the problem we see with our nation.

That is our condition today. Blacks and Hispanics are a decayed people. We are low, and the reason is that we don’t keep God’s commandments. All of us see the condition of our people every day on the way to work: Brooklyn is jacked up, and the Bronx above all.

Our people are broken, and most of our brothers fall into the traps of society and just follow what they see. Most don’t have the discipline, but they can get it with the right leaders, and that is where the brothers come in. Like Judas and his brethren, we are the ones who have to restore our people.

Simon Maccabeus looked at his people and “saw that the people was in great trembling and fear”. This is the time of the Maccabees, when Greece was ruling.

He “went up to Jerusalem, and gathered the people together”. Simon took the initiative: when he saw the problems of his people, he gathered them together.

He “gave them exhortation”. That is what our people need: exhortation. Simon reminded them “what great things I, and my brethren, and my father’s house, have done for the laws and the sanctuary, the battles also and troubles which we have seen.”
“By reason whereof all my brethren are slain for Israel’s sake.” These few scriptures deal with fixing our people: a leader sees the problem in the nation, gathers the people, and exhorts them.

This shows where we came from. “The ambassadors that were sent unto our people certified us of your glory and honour: wherefore we were glad of their coming”. Other nations sent ambassadors to us and honoured us.

Our forefathers “did register the things that they spake in the council of the people”. We had a registry. We had a system, we had administration. We were independent at one time and governed ourselves, though at this time the Greeks were oppressing us. The Jews’ ambassadors, “Numenius son of Antiochus, and Antipater son of Jason”, came “to renew the friendship they had with us.”

So even though we are broken as a people, we had records, we had a system, we had order. The average black man doesn’t know this, because he views the Bible as a white man’s book.

“The Jews and priests were well pleased that Simon should be their governor and high priest for ever, until there should arise a faithful prophet”. Simon was a leader: he was the governor and the high priest.

These men were not prideful enough to make themselves prophets. They understood they were not prophets, and there was no prophet in that time through whom the Most High was communicating to let the people know what to do. Read Kings and Chronicles: there was a king and there was a prophet, and the king consulted the prophet, as King Hezekiah consulted Isaiah. David was both a king and a prophet, and that is what makes David so unique and special, on another level.

The sisters raise their hands when asked who has read Kings and Chronicles, and the brothers who are supposed to be in the streets are looking down. The brothers have to do some reading.
He was made “their captain”, to “take charge of the sanctuary, to set them over their works, and over the country, and over the armour, and over the fortresses”.

“He should be obeyed of every man, and that all the writings in the country should be made in his name”. We were governing ourselves, though the Greeks were oppressing us. A lot of our brothers don’t notice this, and when they hear it they ask what Bible we are reading, because these scriptures are not read.

He was to “be clothed in purple, and wear gold”. Purple and gold are royal colors, and they are the colors of IUIC.

“It should be lawful for none of the people or priests to break any of these things, or to gainsay his words, or to gather an assembly in the country without him, or to be clothed in purple, or wear a buckle of gold”.

This shows that we had order, a government, a registry, administration and records. We literally had a kingdom. Our brothers and sisters don’t know it, and that is why it is important to study. The sisters asking what they are supposed to do: don’t be a dumb woman, be reading the Bible, because the sisters in the streets need to learn.

precepts.why:
This is the exhortation, like Simon’s. The sons of God are the leaders of the earth, and restoring the decayed estate of our nation begins with us. How are we going to remember when we were kings if we don’t go to it?

“When he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book”. This is the king who sits over the kingdom, and we are kings in this building. He writes a copy of this law, not mathematics or anything like that; that wisdom is added after. We have to have this law written down. “Out of that which is before the priests the Levites”: we always had copies of our history, our archives. We had records.

“He shall read therein all the days of his life”, not every other day. That is the type of man who studies and gives you scriptures, who understands how to lead the people by exhorting them with God’s word. Those are the leaders to follow. “That he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them”. That is the example of Judas Maccabeus and of his father, who taught his sons: that household kept the commandments and rehearsed them, because they were leaders.

“That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left”. A man who puts himself up as a leader and does not remember his history or study lifts himself up with his own pride, unlike those humble brothers who understood a prophet had to come to know what to do.

“To the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom”. That is where the saying long live the king comes from: the long life of a king comes from studying the commandments and keeping copies of the writing. This is the King’s code.

sense.text:
These next scriptures are why it is important to study. The Bible says to study. It is good to watch class, but you must also study and read your four chapters.

“Study to shew thyself approved unto God”. Thyself: you are not studying for the captain, you are studying for you.

“A workman that needeth not to be ashamed”. We brothers are workmen; this is our duty.

“Rightly dividing the word of truth” is precept upon precept, line upon line, here a little, there a little. That is how you rightly divide the word of truth.

“Sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer”. Be ready. The only way to be ready is to be studying. Then you are prepared for whatever comes and whoever is in front of you, prepared to win a soul over.

Brothers who don’t study don’t want to be ready. They want to be a Christian, an Uncle Tom, and think they come here just to sit down. This ain’t the Christian church. We are raising up soldiers, and a soldier has to be ready.

Paul thanks the Lord, “who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry”.

We all were wicked as hell. All of us did evil and all of us are worthy of death. Think on what you did in the world: some of you brothers were nasty, some of you sisters were nasty, some of you brothers were violent. In all of our nastiness, perversion, adultery, fornication and wickedness, the Most High said, I could use that brother, I could use that sister to do my work and fix my people.

So we have to thank the Most High for counting us faithful to put us into the ministry. That is why we are here. The Bishop didn’t call you; the Lord called you into this room.
“Seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not”.

We have “renounced the hidden things of dishonesty”. We don’t want to be found dishonest; all of us want to be found honest, “not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully”. “Commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God”: to every man’s mind.

“But if our gospel be hid”. Our gospel is that we are the Israelites, God is black, Christ is black, the angels are black, and we are going to be delivered from oppression if we keep the commandments. That is good news for blacks and Hispanics. But if some people just can’t see it, “it is hid to them that are lost”.

“The god of this world hath blinded the minds”. We study and prepare ourselves to be ready always because we have to go to war against the god of this world. This is a war, brothers, against the white man: we are trying to win the minds of our brothers back to the Lord.

How did he blind the minds? Pass a church on the bus with a Puerto Rican and the hands start shaking and the crucifix comes out. Dominicans darker than you think they are white.

Now into the topic and the timeline. Historically, other nations did keep our laws; there are a few times you read about other nations keeping the laws of the Israelites.

All Israel, their elders, officers and judges stood before the priests the Levites and the ark of the covenant, “as well the stranger, as he that was born among them”. The stranger stood with Israel, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, “that they should bless the people of Israel.”

This is the time of Assyria. The northern kingdom fell to the Assyrian Empire in 722 BC. “The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam”, and Jeroboam was king over the northern kingdom.

The brothers who didn’t know that year: don’t think that because you don’t have a purple shirt you don’t need to study the history. You are not here to be a church student; you are here to be a leader, so you study as well as the rank men.
“Until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight”. This Israel is the northern kingdom, not Judah, not Benjamin, not Levi. “So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.”

“The king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel”.

That was the Assyrian policy: take you out of your homeland, place you in a different country, and put the people of that country in your homeland. That is how Assyria broke a people. It is like taking the people out of Jamaica and putting black Americans there.
These other nations “feared not the Lord: therefore the Lord sent lions among them”. They “know not the manner of the God of the land”, because they were not keeping the commandments.

The king of Assyria sent one of the priests to “teach them the manner of the God of the land.” Reading on, they kept the commandments of the Lord and still served their other gods. But the point is they were learning how to keep the commandments: other nations practicing Judaism.

“Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold”. Mordecai is in the time of the Persian Empire, and the Persian captivity started for the Israelites in 539 BC.
“The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.”

“In every province, and in every city”, wherever the king’s decree came, “the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews”. The people of the land were not Israelites. The heathen were keeping the commandments, “for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.”

Esther was queen at this time. This black woman used her authority to help her people. Somebody should send the Book of Esther to every black woman in America who is a politician or a senator: black woman, learn to love your black brothers. And even with that authority and position she always stayed under the authority of her uncle and took instruction from the man, the Israelite man.

Now the Greek time period, and how the white man went too far. The Greek captivity started for the Israelites in 333 BC.

Alexander “came out of the land of Chettiim”, and Chettiim is Italy. Write it down: when the Bishops and Deacons mention these little points, you write them down and go home and keep studying. This is Alexander the Great, who killed Darius III and “reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”.

They teach our kids in school that civilization started with the Greeks. That is a lie. Watch what our forefathers say about when the Greeks began to rule the world.

He “made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth”, and “took spoils of many nations”, and “his heart was lifted up.” He “ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries unto him.”
“He fell sick, and perceived that he should die”. He was a homosexual.

He “parted his kingdom” among his servants. Those servants were Ptolemy, who ruled Egypt; Cassander, who ruled Macedonia; Lysimachus, who ruled Asia Minor and Thrace; and Seleucus, who ruled Syria. Alexander reigned twelve years and died, and his empire was divided among the four generals.

“After his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.” Our forefathers wrote that when the white man began to rule the world, wickedness increased. Our brothers say that is a white man’s book; they don’t know this is a black man’s book.
“There came out of them a wicked root Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes”.

This leads into how the white man became a Jew: how there are white people today claiming to be Jews, and what Netanyahu is talking about. We read in the Bible what happened.

“In those days arose Mattathias”, “a priest”. He is a Levite. These are the so-called Haitians.
“He had five sons”: Joannan called Caddis, Simon called Thassi, “Judas, who was called Maccabeus”, Eleazar called Avaran, and Jonathan surnamed Apphus. These are the names to know.

Mattathias started a rebellion: we are going to fight the Greeks back, defend the temple, and not let the white man destroy our people; win or lose, we die for the laws. The Most High put the Holy Spirit upon Mattathias.

On his deathbed he says, “ye my sons, be valiant and shew yourselves men in the behalf of the law; for by it shall ye obtain glory.” This is what the black man has never learned. He shows himself a man for the Hoover Crips, for the Bloods, for MS13, for the local drug dealers. We need men to stand up for God’s laws.

“I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear unto him alway: he shall be a father unto you.” He didn’t say I think; he said I know. Mattathias knew his sons.

As parents we need to know our children, and see early which one might leave the truth, which one is showing signs of being a hoe, which one wants to be a gang member, and which one believes. Don’t be ignorant. Watch your kids and see whether the spirit is upon them.

“As for Judas Maccabeus, he hath been mighty and strong, even from his youth up”. Judas was that young brother always fighting, and Mattathias saw it: “let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.” Let Judas lead the battles.
“Take also unto you all those that observe the law”. Keep the men around you that fear the Lord; keep the men in your circle that observe the law.
“Then his son Judas, called Maccabeus, rose up in his stead.”
“All his brethren helped him”. His brothers helped him, “and so did all they that held with his father, and they fought with cheerfulness the battle of Israel.”
“He gat his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant”, “protecting the host with his sword.”

Why do we need a man like Judas? Because the white man destroyed our artwork. They “laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” The Maccabees saw that the white man painted over the artwork we had of our forefathers.

That is iconoclasm, the destruction of art. Teach it on the subway. When the brothers presented at a college, the class asked what iconoclasm is; our people don’t know these things.

The heathen didn’t do that in Kings, in Esther, or in Joshua. There other nations followed our laws. But when the white man took our records, he painted over our forefathers.

precepts.why:
This is why the white man did that: “his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”.

Some black women love the white man. Whatever purple and gold you have on, that white man is in your mind, and you need to get him out of your brain. A black woman running behind a white man is saying, I am giving my soul to this man. Even if a man says he and his white woman have been married however long, it does not matter: God says their soul is not upright. There is something spiritually wrong with them. This is the word of God.

sense.text:
This is the family tree of our ancestors, the Maccabees. The Hasmonean dynasty refers to Simon: Hasmonean is Simeon, so the Hasmonean dynasty is the descendants of Simon. Simon Maccabeus had a son named John Hyrcanus.

The history in Josephus shows what John Hyrcanus did. He conquered the whole of Edom and forced its people to convert to Judaism. He took Dora and Marissa, cities of Idumea, and Idumea is Edom. He let the Idumeans stay in the country if they would circumcise themselves and make use of the laws of the Jews: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy and the other books. They so desired to live in that country that they submitted to circumcision and the Jewish ways of living, and from then on they were no other than Jews. These were white people. Now you have white people wearing fringes, circumcising themselves and keeping the sabbath day, because they were under our government and forced to live under God’s laws.

“Then came up John from Gazera”. This John is John Hyrcanus.

“Simon called his two eldest sons, Judas and John”. It says eldest, not oldest. This is Simon speaking to his son: “I, and my brethren, and my father’s house, have ever from my youth unto this day fought against the enemies of Israel; and things have prospered so well in our hands, that we have delivered Israel oftentimes.”

precepts.why: “When Simon saw that John his son was a valiant man, he made him captain of all the hosts; and he dwelt in Gazera.” That is the same John who comes up from Gazera in 16:1: John Hyrcanus, Simon’s son, the captain of all the hosts.

sense.text: “As concerning the rest of the acts of John, and his wars, and worthy deeds which he did”. This is still John Hyrcanus. Part of those wars were the wars he had against Edom. Our forefathers knew in the records what John did.

“These are written in the chronicles of his priesthood, from the time he was made high priest after his father.” We don’t have that book, so we rely on Josephus and other sources. But Esau knows this. We forced the Edomites to keep the laws of God.

Antipater, the father of Herod the Great, was an Idumean: an Edomite, from the land whose people John Hyrcanus forced to keep the laws. He became a powerful official under the later Hasmonean kings. We promoted white people into our royal courts.

“Never trust thine enemy”. We did not apply this. Judas Maccabeus applied it; he hated them. But later the priesthood became corrupt. Even in the time of the Maccabees you had Jason trying to be high priest, and later on they did not keep the honour of Mattathias and his five sons. So we gave Edomites positions in our court.

“For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Herod killed his wife Mariamne, her two sons, her brother, her grandfather and her mother. You see why the scripture says never trust thine enemy: it was all a plot to take over Judea and the Hasmonean court. This is the history of how the white man stole our heritage.

Don’t trust the white man. Black woman, don’t trust the white man; he does not like you. The sooner we realize the white man is the devil, the better you will be. It doesn’t matter that he gave you a good job. At work he will be friendly, smile, promote you, buy you lunch, and want to know all your secrets and how your marriage is. The white man is crafty.
“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. Be “as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.”

“Set him not by thee”. The saying, keep your friends close and your enemies closer, is not the Bible. Whoever came up with it didn’t have enemies. When you have an enemy, stay far away from him.

Antipater had a position in our court, but he was secretly speaking with the Romans, currying favor with them. He was playing chess: positioning himself as loyal to the Maccabean family while he talked with Rome. When Hyrcanus II and his brother Aristobulus II were fighting, Antipater, a seditious and troublemaking man, exploited the weak-willed Hyrcanus, persuaded him to contend against his brother, and convinced him his brother meant to kill him. Aristobulus was a black man, a Maccabean. The diplomacy and artful politics of Antipater, a crafty snake and a devil, produced the Herodian dynasty, and his son Herod married the Hasmonean princess and usurped the throne of Judea under Rome.

That is what this verse warns of: “lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place; neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.” Hyrcanus set Antipater by him, and this is what took place. Because of Simon Maccabeus we were allowed to govern ourselves under the Greeks, but later the descendants of the Maccabees promoted Edomites to the throne.

precepts.why:
This is what happens when you promote enemies into your circle. “Bring not every man into thine house: for the deceitful man hath many trains”. Antipater is that deceitful man.

The same thing took place in the Persian Empire in the time of Queen Esther. They promoted Haman, an Edomite, who had a position in the Persian court and was plotting to kill the king, until Mordecai told. In the same way we promoted an Edomite into our courts, and he positioned his son Herod to take over our government.

“Like as a partridge taken and kept in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watcheth he for thy fall”. That is what Antipater was doing, and not only him but a bunch of Edomites.

See how it played out. Mariamne, the Hasmonean princess, was a beautiful black woman, a Levite, one of the last heirs of the Hasmonean dynasty that goes back to Simon. Her name is another way of saying Miriam, as Mary is. Herod wanted the throne, and she was a descendant of the Hasmonean dynasty and he was not, so the way to the throne was a marriage. Her mother arranged her betrothal to Herod, and his family had been forced to convert to Judaism, so they were already learning and practicing the laws. Her children by him looked black. But it was all a plot: Herod’s fear of his Hasmonean rivals led him to kill the prominent members of the family, his own wife Mariamne, her children, and her brother Aristobulus III, made high priest at her insistence and drowned before he was eighteen, within a year. The black woman married the white man, and he killed her and her family.

The Maccabean family became like Game of Thrones, brother fighting brother in blood-boiling hatred, the same as in Kings and Chronicles, and the same as families today. The white man, Esau, exploited it.

“Separate thyself from thine enemies, and take heed of thy friends.” Not keep your enemies closer: separate yourself from them.

The problem is that black people don’t know who the enemy is. They think the enemy is Rayquan from apartment 4G. The god of this world has blinded our people, so blacks and Hispanics think each other is the enemy. No: the enemy is all the other nations, starting first with the white man.

sense.text:
Now we understand Daniel 11:14. “Also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.” The robbers of our people are the white man, and the vision they establish is that they are the Jews.

Antipater set up his son Herod to take over the throne. Then Pompey, a general in the Roman army, took Jerusalem, and Jerusalem came under the authority of the Roman Empire. The Herodians had a good relationship with the Romans, so Rome let the Herodians, Esau, rule over us. All because of Antipater: he was in communication with Rome, rose to a position in our court, overthrew us, and set up his son to marry Mariamne, and Herod killed her, her mother, her grandmother, her children and her brother. And Rome said, you look just like us; why don’t you govern Judea.

“Happy art thou, O Israel”. Women always complain that they are not happy, but the scriptures are supposed to make you happy. The fact that you are a Jew, the real Jew, is supposed to make you happy. “Who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord”.

“And thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee”, because they are not the real Jews. The Bible says we are the real Jews, and the Bible finds them to be liars.

precepts.why: “The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables”. Theman is a city in Edom. The scripture calls the Edomites the authors of fables: they are the authors of lies. “None of these have known the way of wisdom”. That is how the enemies are found liars.

sense.text: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.”

“They covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” They oppress not only the man but his heritage: the white man stole our heritage.
“I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me”.

“Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables”. The tables are the Bible, and the vision is what is written in the scriptures. Our job is to take this vision and teach it plainly to the people. Read the history of the Maccabees and you will see they are impostors. They are not the real Jews; they are fake Jews, descendants of Amalek.

“At the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come”. At the end it speaks when we raise our children up to reveal that the son of perdition, the wicked on the planet, is Esau, Edom, the white man.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”. The white man’s soul is not upright in him. Not only did Herod take over, he killed our people, and they kept the same practice of calling themselves Jews from when they converted in the time of John Hyrcanus. Once Herod killed Mariamne and the bloodline and took the throne, Edomites were ruling over Judea: the Herodian family, a noble family of Edomites converted to Judaism.

“Enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers”. That is why we must be studying and prepared: to teach this history of who we really are, and that the white man is the devil. That is part of the gospel. He has to be revealed: according to the Bible, he is not the Jew.
“Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.”
“I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old”. That is what this Bible is: it is filled with parables that our ancestors wrote.

“Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.” The problem with the black man is that he doesn’t even know who his forefathers are. This is where the teachers come in: you have to show them, these are your fathers.

“We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works”. We must be teaching the children the laws and the history of who they are.

“He established a testimony in Jacob”. Jacob is the blacks and Hispanics. He commanded our fathers “that they should make them known to their children”. Our children must know this history: how the white man stole their heritage, that they are the real Jews, and how to prove it. Brothers and sisters, you must be studying.

Rome is ruling now. “When Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king”. How is the white man the king of Judea? We just read the history. His father Antipater set him up; Antipater had a position in the court of the Hasmoneans, and the Hasmoneans go back to the Maccabean family. We promoted Esau into our courts, Herod married a black woman who was a royal princess and killed her, and Rome said, you and your family are going to govern Judea.

By the time of Matthew 2:1, Mariamne, the children and everybody were already dead, and Christ was born, approximately twenty years after Mariamne. So now we understand the history before “there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem”.

This is war: we are showing in detail how the white man stole our heritage, and our people need to hear it.

“How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed?” How are the blacks and Hispanics going to call on Christ, on the Most High, if they never believed on him? Our people have been following the wrong God, worshipping a white man; they never learned the God of the Bible. “How shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard?” When we read these scriptures in the street, people ask what Bible that is, and it is the same Bible they have, but they never read it.

“How shall they hear without a preacher?” How will the brothers in America, in Africa, in Papua New Guinea, in the Eastern Hemisphere hear this gospel? We need teachers and preachers. We need you brothers to join the movement so you can learn how to teach.

“How shall they preach, except they be sent?” You know you are sent because you are sitting in this room; the Most High called you. Now you need to make your calling and election sure.

“How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” That is why we have to move from city to city and travel. It means sacrificing your time and your sleep. You did it in the world, clubbing until four in the morning and going to work at six-thirty; you can put in the work for the Most High.
“But they have not all obeyed the gospel.” “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”

“Their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.” Their sound is this gospel. We need to be making noise, traveling all through America, Africa, Europe and South America, and to go through all the earth we need passports. Never give up, never give in.
